items.title: What Is Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Telling Investors With Its AI Security Push?
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) introduced TRACE, an open specification for verifiable AI runtime evidence, now under Linux Foundation governance.
